strings.title: Use a Fact You Know
strings.label: Bank
strings.strategy: Use a fact you know to work out one you don't: one more group (5 × 7 to 6 × 7), or one group less (10 × 6 to 9 × 6).
strings.keywords: groups of, fact, one more group, one less group, array, row
watchFor: Adding one instead of one group (6 × 7 = 35 + 1): ask "What does one more row of the array look like?"
Taking away the wrong group (9 × 8 = 80 − 9): ask "Which number is the group of? What did you take away?"
Counting by ones on the array: ask "Is there a row you already know?"
strings.wrapUp: Ask "How did 5 × 7 help with 6 × 7? How did 10 × 6 help with 9 × 6?" Land: one more group means add one group; one less group means take one group away. The array shows which group.

problems.notes: Look for: 5 groups of 7, or 7 groups of 5 (counting by fives). Ask: "How do you know it's 35?" Model: array 5 x 7

responses.tip: Ask: is it 5 rows of 7, or 7 rows of 5? Does it matter?
A great fives strategy. Ask: why half?

problems.notes: Look for: 5 × 7 = 35, plus one more 7. Ask: "How does 5 × 7 help?" Word choice: "one more group of 7". Model: area 5+1 x 7

responses.tip: Doubling. Also a fact you know.
Added one, not one group. Ask: what does one more row look like?

problems.notes: Look for: half of 10 × 8. Ask: "Which fact do you already know?" Model: array 5 x 8
Look for: 5 × 8 = 40, plus one more 8. Ask: "What's the same as 6 × 7?" Model: area 5+1 x 8

responses.tip: Ask: one more group of what?

problems.notes: Look for: 10 groups of 6. Ask: "Hold on to this one." Model: array 10 x 6

responses.tip: Ask: hold on to this. It will help next.

problems.notes: Look for: 10 × 6 = 60, take away one 6. Ask: "How does 10 × 6 help?" Word choice: "one less group of 6". Model: area 10-1 x 6

responses.say: 10 sixes is 60, take away one 6 is 54.
responses.tip: The target strategy: one group less.
Splitting into two facts. It works too.
Took away a 9 instead of a 6. Ask: which number is the group?

problems.notes: Look for: 10 × 8 = 80, take away one 8. Ask: "Which group do you take away?" Model: area 10-1 x 8

responses.tip: Ask: 9 groups of 8. Which group is missing from 10 groups?
